title: Legacyte Harvest/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: Transmissions during a Legacyte Harvest mission.

- Eleanor: "It is harvest time. Your crop? The Techrot Legacyte. An evolving beast that consumes untold resources during gestation. Harvest enough of them and perhaps we can deplete the Techrot. Kalymos is prowling nearby. She'll guide you to your target."

- Eleanor: "We shall starve the Techrot of vital nutrients by forcing it to create Legacyte after Legacyte. Fair warning: each beast will be stronger than the last. If you are still game, follow Kalymos."

- Eleanor: "As a beehive works tirelessly to support its Queen, the Techrot hoards resources to grow and evolve its Legacytes. We will harvest its precious Legacytes and nip its growth in the bud. Follow Kalymos. She will track your prey."
- Eleanor: "Find Kalymos. Let her know you are ready."
- Eleanor: "Good. Keep her safe while she sniffs out the Techrot's darling Legacyte."
- Eleanor: "That's it, Kalymos! Good girl! Now, we are not going to let any harm come to that precious feline, are we?"
- Eleanor: "Kalymos will have the Legacyte's trail soon. Ensure her safety."
- Eleanor: "Kalymos has its scent. Keep her safe."
- Eleanor: "Another Legacyte has finished gestating. Kalymos has the scent."
- Eleanor: "(Gasps) I feel the birth of a new Legacyte."
- Eleanor: "And again, the Techrot spawns a Legacyte. It has learned. It is stronger."
- Eleanor: "The Techrot is relentless, its stamina unending. We must match its resolve."
- Eleanor: "Techrot Pheroglands. Grab them, and take them to Kalymos."
- Eleanor: "Grab those Pheroglands and let Kalymos have a whiff of them. That will help her find our target."
- Eleanor: "Pheroglands. Reeking, saturated with hormones, and a sure sign a Legacyte is nearby. Kalymos wants a sniff."
- Eleanor: "Kalymos is hurt! She's recovering, but you need to protect her."
- Eleanor: "Kalymos! Quickly now. To her side."
- Eleanor: "She hurts. You must protect her or she cannot help you."
- Eleanor: "Kalymos is working hard to find the Legacyte for us, so the least we can do is protect her, don't you agree?"
- Eleanor: "They've hurt her. Rally to her side while she recovers."
- Eleanor: "Kalymos is in pain. She cannot track the Legacyte unprotected."
- Eleanor: "Kalymos found the Legacyte. Harvest it!"
- Eleanor: "Our faithful Kavat has roused the prey. Bring it down and drain it."
- Eleanor: "There it is. The Techrot's latest debutante. Take it down."
- Eleanor: "Another stirs. What horrific adaptations has this one developed?"
- Eleanor: "Your target has surfaced! Take it down before it dives back into the mulch!"
- Eleanor: "She has done it. Legacyte in the area. Your rightful prey. Take it!"
- Eleanor: "A beast as voracious as the Techrot itself."
- Eleanor: "Legacytes are not your average Techrot conglomeration of electronics and biomass. They are more evolved, more akin to Warframes."
- Eleanor: "The Techrot learns from you, and others like you. It sees your powers and copies them."
- Eleanor: "Techrot; it consumes, and it learns. And the only thing we can do is try to destroy it."
- Eleanor: "It's on the move. It must not escape or we'll never find it again, and this mission will be a failure."
- Eleanor: "It's trying to run! Stop it. Escape is failure."
- Eleanor: "The beast seeks sanctuary. Give it no quarter."
- Eleanor: "It's on the run. Give chase."
- Eleanor: "It's scared and wants to escape. Finish it first."
- Eleanor: "It has been broken. Harvest it."
- Eleanor: "Hurry, harvest now. End this generation."

- Eleanor: "It is done. Either flee to extraction now, or if you have it in you, ask Kalymos to find the next Legacyte. Remember, the Techrot evolves quickly, and your next battle will be harder still."
- Eleanor: "Sweet Lua! I can see it. All that was taken from Höllvania and her people. Funneled into this... monster."
- Eleanor: "With every Legacyte we cut down, a new one instantly emerges. How deep does this go?"
- Eleanor: "Do not mourn for the Legacyte. It is but one appendage of the sprawling Techrot mass."
- Eleanor: "It will learn from what you just did to it. Harvest again, but know it will be tougher next time."
- Eleanor: "So we reclaim what the Techrot has taken from us."
- Eleanor: "Kalymos is ready to hunt again."
- Eleanor: "Our feline friend yearns for another hunt. Will you oblige?"
- Eleanor: "If you need to leave, know that Legacytes this far evolved can rarely sustain themselves for more than a couple of days."
- Eleanor: "We thank Sol for this bountiful harvest."
- Eleanor: "What you take now, will help us in the future."
- Eleanor: "Kalymos is ready for more. Are you?"
- Eleanor: "Remember, we harvest the Techrot's offspring to protect humanity."
- Eleanor: "The next one will not be easy."
- Eleanor: "We are teaching the rot how to fight like a Warframe. Yet I see no other way."
- Eleanor: "With each Legacyte I can hear the Techrot's screams grow louder. Make it hurt."
- Eleanor: "How many more can you bring down? How long can you last?"
- Eleanor: "Surely this is the last, unless… heh. Do I sense the fighting urge still burning in you?"
- Eleanor: "It's gone. This mission is a total loss."
- Eleanor: "You let it get away! Kalymos has completely lost the scent. There is nothing more you can do. Come home."
- Eleanor: "The beast has fled. It'll go into hiding and no new Legacyte will gestate. Nothing more to do but head to extraction."
- Eleanor: "A formidable effort. Do you think you can do more next time?"
- Eleanor: "You have dealt the Techrot a great blow."
- Eleanor: "The Techrot is in agony. A cause for celebration. Cheers."
- Eleanor: "I don't know who is more satisfied with this outing, myself... or Kalymos."
- Eleanor: "Your physical fortitude is matched only by your mental fitness."
- Eleanor: "What drives you so hard? Those Legacytes never stood a chance."
